slides.title: Spark Day, every channel at once
slides.text: Spark Day, and the Magpie flock strikes on every channel at once: fake letters in the sacks, a prize poster on the door, and a postmark faked to look like Pim's own.
slides.alt: Escape the Post Office at Pro: six trick locks guard the sorting room door, one for each Defender stamp, and none is open yet.

focus.cue: Spark Day: fake letters, a prize poster, a faked postmark
The six trick locks on the sorting room door

slides.title: Six locks, harder contents
slides.text: The sorting room is locked with the same six trick locks, cut harder this year. Inside the locks wait a spoofed sender, a pressure play, and a Trick Inbox round of eight items.
slides.alt: Pim opens the Netville map: houses, roads and the first message waiting to be delivered.

focus.cue: The Netville map and the first message

slides.title: Your stamps are the keys
slides.text: Pim, locked out beside you, lays out your six stamps. Each stamp proves a trained skill, and each lock tests exactly that skill. Nothing in the room is new. All of it is combined.
slides.alt: Sealed roads wear padlocks: open roads cost one hop, but a snoopy cat reads every packet on them.

focus.cue: Nothing in the room is new: every road combined

slides.title: Read the room first
slides.text: Before touching a lock, a Defender reads the room. Match each lock to the unit that trained it.
steps: Sorting Gate and Sealed Note: Units 1 and 2
Which Pim? and the inbox round: Units 3 and 4
slides.alt: Secret Messages in Pro: the cipher wheel waits with a scrambled message only the key can open.

focus.cue: The cipher wheel, with a scrambled message
DSSOH: turn the wheel until the reading makes sense

slides.title: Fair rules, honest shield
slides.text: The room keeps its fair rules: no fail state, and the parade clock changes only the celebration, never the outcome. Hint feathers you spend are printed honestly on your shield.
slides.alt: The sealed route: a message travels a road marked sealed, the padlock idea played as a journey.

focus.cue: A message travelling a road marked sealed

slides.title: Your Defender words
slides.text: No new words today. These four carried the whole course.

words.means: a person who keeps people and messages safe
to check a claim against another trusted source
something that has gone wrong with security or safety
stacking independent layers so one failure is never the whole story

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Escape the Post Office and play Escape the Post Office. Open all six locks, earn your Defender shield, and take the debrief page to your teacher.
slides.alt: Escape the Post Office at Pro: six trick locks guard the sorting room door, one for each Defender stamp, and none is open yet.
